headline: Imperial Oil (TSX:IMO) Board Reshuffle Brings In Director From Its Majority Owner
summary: Imperial Oil (TSX:IMO) announced a board change following the resignation of an existing director. A senior executive from ExxonMobil, Imperial Oil’s majority owner, has been appointed to the board as a new director. The move further links Imperial Oil’s governance to ExxonMobil through direct board representation.
